text:
tanya_sales: FYI Cerbero is pushing hard on their pilot. Key asks: BYO HSM (FIPS 140-2/3), 99th%-ile latency <=75ms for chat path, strict egress caps (they want predictable monthly max), and EU + AP-SE data residency for test. Exec wants an options doc before Tuesday. Who owns which pieces? :triage:

raj_se: I can own the technical run-through. Quick Q: do they require remote HSM or will a key import suffice? If remote, we need compatibility matrix with our KMS proxies.

oliver_infra: Remote HSM (PKCS#11) is doable but needs a connector and a perf test. Importable keys are faster to onboard. Perf note: remote HSM adds overhead on signing ops; we'll need to quantify. Also regional routing needs a Dedicated pool in ap-southeast-1 for residency.

tanya_sales: They explicitly said "HSM-backed; remote preferred." That complicates cost/latency.

emma_pm: For latency SLOs, suggest a Dedicated config: reserved GPUs in ap-southeast-1, KV cache enabled, and prefix caching. Can run a 2-week canary with traffic shaping to validate 99th%-ile. I'll sketch the canary plan.

mike_finance: About the egress cap: they want a predictable monthly ceiling with overage billing at a pre-negotiated rate. We can propose a committed spend + overage tiers. What's their expected token/month?

tanya_sales: They quoted ~300M tokens/month for full rollout; pilot is ~10M tokens. They want pilot pricing to be capped at $X and then transition.

nina_legal: I'll prepare a BYO-HSM addendum: responsibilities, auditing rights, key escrow limitations, and attestation requirements. Also need to confirm export controls for AP-SE data. If they push for key custody changes, we need a short timeline for legal review.

raj_se: For the exec doc I'll include two flows:
- Flow A: Remote HSM (PKCS#11 tenant-proxy) with fallthrough to Redwood-managed tenant key
- Flow B: Imported HSM-wrapped key (faster, lower latency)
I'll attach perf deltas. Example snippet to call proxy:
```
POST /v1/keys/sign
{ "key_id": "cerbero-hsm-01", "payload": "..." }
```

oliver_infra: Perf estimates: remote HSM cold path +40-80ms per first sign, steady-state +10-20ms if we batch/caching. Dedicated in-region reduces network jitter. We should promise a target but say we need canary validation for formal SLA.

deploy-bot: Ticket INF-11022 opened: Cerbero HSM connector + ap-southeast-1 Dedicated pool testing (assignee: oliver_infra).

emma_pm: Proposal: 2-week canary, 10% pilot credit if canary meets latency and security checklist, otherwise revert to a zero-credit trial. Keeps risk low.

mike_finance: 10% credit okay provisional. Need runway to present a simple TCO slide on Fri for execs. Can someone provide expected cost delta for remote HSM vs import?

raj_se: I'll add estimated CPU/GPU hours and HSM ops cost to the deck. Expect HSM ops to add non-GPU cost; will provide ranges.

nina_legal: Also flagging: we need to update our standard SOC2 attestation paragraph to include HSM integration caveats. Will draft language tonight.

tanya_sales: I'll coordinate the exec invite. Can we get the tech + legal + finance one-pager by Thu EOD so I can circulate?

oliver_infra: INF-11022: I'll post a short runbook and provisional perf numbers by Wed. Need access details from Cerbero for the HSM endpoints.

raj_se: Quick ask to Cerbero on the call: can they provide a test HSM with logs and throughput profile? If not, we scope a lab test with one of our partners.

nina_legal: Also preparing a minimal checklist for attestation: vendor cert, FIPS level, key rotation policy, access logs retention, and data residency confirmation.

tanya_sales: Great. I'll pull the existing security questionnaire answers into the exec packet and annotate open items. Please flag anything blocking. :thumbsup:

mike_finance: I'll draft the TCO slide with two pricing scenarios (committed + overage tiers) and a pilot cap option. Will sync with raj for numbers.

oliver_infra: Blocking ask: access creds for a test HSM and a firm pilot IP allowlist for ap-southeast-1.

emma_pm: Noted. I'll also include rollback plan (switch to Redwood-managed keys + traffic shaping) in case HSM connector fails during canary.

deploy-bot: INF-11022 updated: runbook assigned, perf test scheduled Thu.

tanya_sales: Thanks team. Exec brief scheduled Tue 9am SGT (Mon 9pm PT). Please have deliverables in Slack by Thu EOD SGT.
